description: Land Title Settlement Department - Weligaga, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No.  320042 (23/0948)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically declarations of determination regarding title to specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (including transfers to The State and Land Reforms Commission), and other land-specific particulars. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
